Venezuela to attend US-hosted G20 energy talks in Texas

Venezuela has accepted an invitation from the United States to attend G20 energy talks in Houston, Texas. The invitation and Venezuela's acceptance come as the U.S. is pushing for greater oil and gas production, a policy termed "energy abundance." The G20 meeting also presents geopolitical complications due to the expected presence of Russian officials.
